gen-gf-unkempt-fs-rowan: Rough, loud and full of character. Unkempt keeps its curves at a single thickness, while Rowan, a serif with a tempered contrast, settles the text down without flattening it.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-paquito: Wallpoet cuts its letters with a hard, stencil-like gap running through. Paquito, a text serif with barely any step from lowercase to capitals, gives that swagger a friendly, confident partner.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-paquito: Expressive ink strokes taper to a point in Warnes, with stretched, spacious tracking and no thick or thin at all. But Paquito, a text serif with a low contrast of its own, brings the page back to approachable ground.
gen-megrim-fs-paquito: Megrim looks angular and futuristic, every stroke measured out. Paquito, a classic serif, then carries paragraphs with a confident, approachable voice, its capitals sitting barely above the lowercase so the lines flow smoothly.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and friendly, with capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Size it up for the body text, and Mystery Quest supplies a bookish, nostalgic heading with compact ascenders above its tall lowercase.
gen-nixie-one-fs-rowan: Nostalgic and retro-tech, Nixie One draws thin, constant lines with open curves. Rowan, a classic serif with generous openings and a modest stem-to-hairline ratio, gives it a literary, friendly counterweight that feels distinct.
gen-gf-funnel-display-manrope: Commanding spaghetti-like strokes give Funnel Display its voice, all one width and nothing fussy. And Manrope, a sans-serif with bright openings at every curve, carries the text in an approachable, clean way.
gen-gf-goldman-satoshi: Goldman spreads wide, bold letters with round forms like open parentheses. Satoshi, a sans-serif with a soaring x-height, is the pair's strongest card: its strokes all cut to one width against that sweep.
gen-gf-grandstander-work-sans: Work Sans sets a contemporary, modern tone, with a high mean line and joins as thick as its strokes. Work Sans, a plain sans, would read steadily over a longer passage, while Grandstander shouts boldly above it.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads professional and trustworthy, with a hefty lowercase and broad open counters. Public Sans, a sans, would carry a longer passage smoothly, while Gugi's bold, distinctive heading letters stand tall above it.
